usageNotes: Returns the firewall directory index for PVE remotes managed by PDM — use this to discover available firewall sub-resources (e.g., rules, aliases, IPSets) before making targeted sub-resource calls. No parameters are required and no specific privilege beyond a valid PDM API token is needed. The return value is documented as null in the spec, meaning the useful payload is the directory listing embedded in the response envelope.

examples.summary: List all available firewall sub-resources on the PDM PVE surface

tips: This is a discovery/index endpoint — use the returned sub-resource paths to construct follow-up calls for firewall rules, aliases, or IPSets.
Accessible with any valid PDM API token; no elevated privileges required.
Because the spec marks returns.type as null, the actual directory data arrives in the standard Proxmox API response envelope under the 'data' key.
